title: The Safety Network, session recaps, and chipping in for Premium
changes: New: the Safety Network. Servers can share their bans, and when someone banned by other servers joins yours, your staff get a warning with the reasons and buttons to ban or kick. Turn it on in /setup under Safety Network. Nobody is banned automatically unless you choose that, which is part of Premium

New: session recaps. When the last officer goes off patrol, the bot posts what the session added up to: patrol time, 911 calls, arrests, tickets, warrants, impounds and the top officers. They go to your patrol report channel, or pick one with /recap channel. Post one any time with /recap now

New: members can chip in for Premium. Anyone in your server can put $2, $3 or $5 toward it from /premium, and every $5 raised turns Premium on for a month. You get a message each time someone chips in
When a free trial ends, the server now has 48 hours to get its first month of Premium at half price, $2.50
Getting ready for GTA 6? The server directory has a new Getting ready for GTA 6 tag, so players looking for a GTA 6 server can find yours
Fixed: a server that bought Premium during its free trial was still told the trial had ended and Premium had stopped
